sentences.text:
PETITIONER/ACCUSED:
 VIVEK RAJKUMAR AGED 34 YEARS TC II/2199.1, SIVAM, RKV ROAD,
 KANAKAKKUNNU PALACE LANCE, VIKAS BHAVAN, THIRUVANTHAPURAM.
NOW  RESIDING AT ARTECH KALYANI APARTMENT, VAZHUTHACAUD, NEAR TAGORE  THEATRE, THIRUVANANTHAPURAM.

RESPONDENTS/STATE & DEFACTO COMPLAINANT:
 1. THE STATE OF KERALA, REPRESENTED BY PUBLIC PROSECUTOR, HIGH COURT OF  KERALA, ERNAKULAM - 682031, AND ANOTHER  Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the  High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings in Anx.1, i.e,
 C.C.No.665 of 2022 for offence punishable U/sec.498A I.P.C. pending on the  file of the JFMC, Koothuparamba until further orders in the interest of  justice  This Criminal Misc. case again coming on for orders, upon persuing  the petition and this Court's order dated 26.06.2024 in Crl MA 1/2022 and  upon hearing the arguments of M/s. SASTHAMANGALAM S. AJITHKUMAR and  SREEJITH S. NAIR, Advocates for the petitioner, PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the  1st respondent and of M/s. SURESH P.G. and ASWATHY KRISHNAN, Advocates for  the 2nd respondent, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
The matter is settled and the Mediation agreement would be executed without much delay is the submission of both sides.
Hence, post along with the mediation agreement, if any, to consider the settlement, on 12.11.2024.
Interim order is extended till then.
